name: Trust Badges
summary: Passive native list of short text-complete commercial assurances with optional decorative visuals and target-owned claims.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native unordered list containing one or more valid assurance statements and an optional localized accessible name.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item for one independent target-supplied assurance.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional decorative visual that reinforces but never carries or verifies the visible statement.

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible text that completely communicates the target-owned assurance.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Body Small statement typography and default wrapping gaps.

variants.name: compact
variants.description: Caption statement typography and reduced wrapping gaps for dense product or cart contexts.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic content-sized collection whose wrapping responds to its own available inline space.

states.name: default
states.description: Populated passive assurance list with no focus, live-region, motion, controlled state, or neutral runtime.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
attributes: role="list" when marker removal would otherwise weaken list exposure
behavior.description: The collection uses native ul/li semantics, preserves target source order, and adds no widget role or keyboard model.

behavior.name: textCompleteItems
behavior.description: Every valid item has non-empty visible text that stands alone; optional visuals are redundant, decorative, and excluded from the accessibility tree.

behavior.name: omission
behavior.description: Targets omit blank or icon-only items and omit the complete root when no valid visible statement remains.

behavior.name: intrinsicWrapping
behavior.description: Items wrap from the component content box without viewport queries, visual reordering, truncation, or Studio-only layout repair.

behavior.name: targetClaimOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own claim truth, evidence, qualifications, localization, jurisdiction, publication, updates, and any related policy destination; presentation never certifies a claim.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more target-owned native list-item compositions containing required non-empty visible statement text and an optional decorative visual.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit aria-label when surrounding visible context already identifies the collection.
properties.description: Optional localized accessible list name used only when surrounding visible context does not already identify the assurances.

accessibility: Render the collection as a native ul/li list, preserving source order and adding role=list only as a marker-removal exposure safeguard.
Require every item to communicate its complete assurance through non-empty visible text; icon-only items are invalid.
Hide every redundant icon or image from assistive technology with aria-hidden or empty alt so it does not duplicate the statement.
Use an optional localized accessibleLabel only when surrounding visible context does not already identify the collection.
Do not add focus stops, controls, widget roles, live regions, keyboard behavior, motion, controlled state, or neutral runtime to passive assurances.
Permit long, localized, RTL, unbroken, and enlarged statement text to wrap without clipping, truncation, overlap, or visual reordering.
Leave claim truth, evidence, qualifications, localization, jurisdiction, publication, updates, and related policy navigation with the target.

web.notes: Implemented as a conditionally rendered native list with text-complete items, optional decorative visuals, semantic typography, intrinsic wrapping, and no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Merchant section maps non-empty statement blocks to canonical native list anatomy, optional decorative target images, localized schema metadata, strict empty omission, and no component runtime.
